Procurement Operations Analyst

PT Chandra Asri Sentral Solusi (CASS) is a subsidiary of PT Chandra Asri Pacific Tbk (Chandra Asri Group) established to deliver Shared Service Center (SSC) solutions that support the Group’s growing business operation.

Our commitment is to empower Chandra Asri Group’s transformation and long-term growth by becoming a trusted strategic partner in business support and service delivery.

CASS plays a vital role in enhancing efficiency, standardizing process and driving operational excellence across the Group’s subsidiaries-including entities based in Singapore.

Job Purposes

We are seeking an experienced Supply Chain Spot Buy Analyst to join our dynamic team in the oil and gas or petrochemical industry. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in managing contracting and procurement processes, contract negotiation, tender evaluation while staying compliant with procurement policies.

This role requires a strategic thinker with strong analytical capabilities, capable of executing timely, compliant, and cost-effective purchases while maintaining clear communication with stakeholders, managing supplier relationships with accountability, and proactively driving continuous process improvements

ACCOUNTABILITY

• Apply the Contract & Procurement best practices while focusing on contribution to the business drivers and not compromising on compliance for HSSE, Ethics & Compliance, Code of Conduct, Laws, and regulations.
• Conduct identification of need, finding and qualifying the suppliers, requesting proposals, negotiating with suppliers, contracting, delivery and analyzing resultsWork closely with cross-functional teams to assess potential suppliers and ensure transparent, fair, and competitive bidding processes.
• Perform comprehensive financial and commercial analysis of bids to ensure alignment with technical specifications, budgetary constraints, and strategic goals.
• Lead contract negotiations with suppliers and vendors to secure favorable terms, pricing, and conditions, while ensuring compliance with legal and regulatory requirements.
• Perform various procurement and support functions including vendor data administration as well as invoice and payment processing
• Develop and maintain strong relationships with key suppliers and stakeholders to identify possibility to shift recurring spot buys into strategic sourcing or contracts.
• Develop and manage a reliable supplier base, ensuring compliance with company standards and resolving delivery, quality, and service issue.
• Manage Supplier Relationship effectively and collaboratively drive continuous performance improvement via relevant contract key metrics (EG: HSSE, Operations, Cost, etc).
• Monitor supplier performance and implement corrective actions to address any deviations from contractual obligations or service level agreements.

QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business or Engineering majors or related field.
• Minimum of 5 years of experience in supply chain management, contracting and procurement. Experience in the oil and gas or petrochemical industries are preferred but not mandatory.
• Proven experience in contract negotiation, tender evaluation, supplier relationship management and contract management.
• Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
• Ability to act with urgency, accountability and manage multiple tasks and prioritize responsibilities.
• Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
• Proficient in English both written and speaking and able to communicate in business language.
• Strong analytical skills with proficiency in using data analysis tools and software.
• Experience with enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, such as SAP or Oracle.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel and PowerPoint.

If you’re ready to bring your skills to a dynamic environment where your work makes an impact across industries and borders, we’d love to hear from you. Join us at Chandra Asri Group and be part of shaping a smarter, more connected future. Apply today!

Important Notes

Chandra Asri is only releasing official job posting at Chandra Asri Career Site (careers.chandra-asri.com), Linkedin & Jobstreet. The Company will contact shortlisted candidate via official corporate email & phone, and will not send any hardcopy invitation for interview. Please note that the Company doesn’t ask candidates to transfer some amount of money nor cooperate with any travel agent.

BEWARE OF RECRUITMENT SCAM.

wo-jpfa-JR4687.d:
PT Japfa Food Indonesia (Wonoayu)

Job Responsibilities**

* Operate a reach truck safely and efficiently to load, unload, stack, and move products and materials within the warehouse.
* Perform daily pre-operation and post-operation checks of the reach truck, reporting any defects or malfunctions immediately.
* Ensure accurate and timely storage and retrieval of goods according to established procedures.
* Adhere to all safety regulations and company policies, including proper handling of materials and equipment.
* Assist with inventory management tasks, including counting and recording stock movements.
* Maintain a clean and organized work area.
* Communicate effectively with warehouse supervisors and team members regarding operational issues or concerns.
* Support other warehouse activities as required, including general labor tasks when not operating the reach truck.

Job Qualifications**

* Minimum of 1-2 years of experience operating a reach truck in a warehouse or logistics environment.
* Valid and current forklift operator certification, specifically for reach trucks (FG-2 classification or equivalent).
* Proven ability to operate equipment safely and efficiently, with a strong understanding of warehouse safety protocols.
* Good physical condition, capable of lifting and moving heavy objects as needed.
* Ability to read and understand basic instructions and safety manuals.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy in handling materials.
* Good communication and teamwork skills.
* High school diploma or equivalent.

JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. We believe our people are the key to staying ahead, and we continuously seek talented individuals to grow with us and contribute to our mission.

Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.
